arxiv-2104-04539.title: Bethe Algebra using Pure Spinors
arxiv-2104-04539.creator: Simon Ekhammar, Dmytro Volin
arxiv-2104-04539.description: Abstract We explore a 𝔤 ​ 𝔩 r {\mathfrak{gl}}_{r} -covariant parameterisation of Bethe algebra appearing in 𝔰 ​ 𝔬 2 ​ r {\mathfrak{so}}_{2r} integrable models, demonstrate its geometric origin from a fused flag, and use it to compute the spectrum of periodic rational spin chains, for various choices of the rank r r and Drinfeld polynomials.

arxiv-2112-13721.title: Variational symplectic diagonally implicit Runge-Kutta methods for isospectral systems Journal: BIT Thanks: Funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 422037413 – TRR 287.
arxiv-2112-13721.creator: Clauson Carvalho da Silva, Christian Lessig
arxiv-2112-13721.description: Abstract Isospectral flows appear in a variety of applications, e.g. the Toda lattice in solid state physics or in discrete models for two-dimensional hydrodynamics, with the isospectral property often corresponding to mathematically or physically important conservation laws. Their most prominent feature, i.e. the conservation of the eigenvalues of the matrix state variable, should therefore be retained when discretizing these systems.

arxiv-2208-02400.title: Evolutionary bagging for ensemble learning Journal: Neurocomputing
arxiv-2208-02400.creator: Giang Ngo, Rodney Beard, Rohitash Chandra
arxiv-2208-02400.description: Abstract Ensemble learning has gained success in machine learning with major advantages over other learning methods. Bagging is a prominent ensemble learning method that creates subgroups of data, known as bags, that are trained by individual machine learning methods such as decision trees. Random forest is a prominent example of bagging with additional features in the learning process.

arxiv-2402-01812.title: Distilling LLMs’ Decomposition Abilities into Compact Language Models
arxiv-2402-01812.creator: Denis Tarasov & Kumar Shridhar
arxiv-2402-01812.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated proficiency in their reasoning abilities, yet their large size presents scalability challenges and limits any further customization. In contrast, compact models offer customized training but often fall short in solving complex reasoning tasks. This study focuses on distilling the LLMs’ decomposition skills into compact models using offline reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2410-21103.title: Stability of nearly Kähler and nearly parallel G 2 G_{2} -manifolds Thanks: enric.sole-farre.21@ucl.ac.uk
arxiv-2410-21103.creator: Enric Solé-Farré
arxiv-2410-21103.description: Abstract . We investigate generalisations of Hitchin’s functionals, whose critical points correspond to nearly Kähler and nearly parallel G 2 G_{2} -structures. We focus on the gradient flow of these functionals and the spectral decomposition of their Hessians with respect to natural indefinite inner products. We introduce a Morse-like index for these functionals, termed the Hitchin index.

arxiv-2411-08688.title: incompressibleFoam : a new time consistent framework with BDF and DIRK integration schemes
arxiv-2411-08688.creator: Paulin FERRO*, Pierre-Etienne MEILLER, Paul LANDEL, Carla LANDRODIE, Marc PESCHEUX
arxiv-2411-08688.description: Abstract This work focuses on the development of a new incompressible solver, incompressibleFoam , within OpenFOAM and integrating several numerical methods within the same framework . Two momentum interpolation ( NCMI/CMI ) methods are implemented, as well as two forms of the pressure Poisson equation (corrected/standard) .

arxiv-2509-00512.title: Event-by-event vortex rings in fixed-target p+Ar collisions

Our predictions for their imprints on Lambda hyperon’s polarization observables are complementary to those presented in Ref. [Phys.Rev.

pmc-10546931.title: Exploration of Immune Targets for Type 1 Diabetes and Latent Autoimmune Disease Immunotherapy
pmc-10546931.creator: Khalid Siddiqui, Shaik Sarfaraz Nawaz
pmc-10546931.description: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is an autoimmune disease that destroys pancreatic beta cells, which produce insulin in the islets of Langerhans. The risk of developing T1D is influenced by environmental factors, genetics, and autoantibodies. Latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA) is a type of T1D that is genetically and phenotypically distinct from classic T1D.

pmc-11390522.title: Sex differences in opioid response: a role for the gut microbiome?
pmc-11390522.creator: Caitlin Han, Melissa T. Manners, Shivon A. Robinson
pmc-11390522.description: Opioid drugs have been long known to induce different responses in males compared to females, however, the molecular mechanisms underlying these effects are yet to be fully characterized. Recent studies have established a link between the gut microbiome and behavioral responses to opioids.

pmc-11577299.title: Bortezomib before and after high‐dose therapy in transplant‐eligible patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma: Long‐term overall survival after more than 10 years of follow‐up from the phase III HOVON‐65/GMMG‐HD4 trial

pmc-12411848.title: Simultaneous laparoscopic management of dual primary malignancies: case reports and literature review of synchronous renal cell carcinoma and colon carcinoma of sigmoid
pmc-12411848.creator: Settanan Plangsiri, Pat Ngamdachakij, Manisara Jirapornsuwan, Panupol Thepyasuwan, Chanakarn Sribangpleenoi, Panjapon Kitgrongpaibul, Varinthip Thongchai, Songyos Tangmesang
pmc-12411848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Dual primary malignancy is a rare but possible malignancy presentation. Here, we present two cases of synchronous renal cell cancer and colon cancer with simultaneous laparoscopic management. The first patient, a 65-year-old female, reported painless hematochezia, while the second, a 73-year-old female, complained of painful bloating and constipation, along with a palpable mass in the left lower quadrant of the abdomen. A computed tomography (CT) scan of both patients’ abdomens revealed the expected colonic masses.

pmc-12603045.title: Characterizing and screening of wheat genotypes under salinity stress condition using thermography and multivariate techniques
pmc-12603045.creator: Koushik Banerjee, Prameela Krishnan, Arvind Kumar, Arijit Barman, Debasish Roy, Suman Sen, Brijesh Yadav
pmc-12603045.description: Salinity is one of the major abiotic stresses affecting the growth and yield of wheat crops, particularly in arid and semi-arid regions, where irrigation water or soil with high salt content is often present. With increasing soil salinization and abrupt climate change at the global level, identifying salt-tolerant wheat genotypes has become crucial.

pmc-12712691.title: A Case Report of Primary Pulmonary Lymphoepithelioma-Like Carcinoma with “Harmful” Pseudoprogression and a Pathological Complete Response (pCR) after Immunotherapy Plus Radiotherapy
pmc-12712691.creator: Si Qin, Shu Tang, Lijiao Xie, Jianbo Zhu, Jianguo Sun
pmc-12712691.description: BackgroundPrimary pulmonary lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma (PPLELC) is a rare subtype of primary non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with no established treatment guidelines. We present a case of a young female with PPLELC who achieved a pathological complete response (pCR) in both primary and metastatic lesions after receiving combined immunotherapy and radiotherapy.

pmc-12836933.title: Long non-coding RNAs in osteosarcoma: multifaceted regulators of malignancy and therapeutic resistance
pmc-12836933.creator: Pei Liu, Weiwei Wang, Hong Zhang, Ming Qiang Liu, Jianlei Li, Yuanyin Teng, Kun Zhao, Anquan Shang, Yongqiang Sun
pmc-12836933.description: BackgroundOsteosarcoma (OS) is the most common primary malignant bone tumor in children and adolescents, with an annual incidence of approximately 3–4 cases per million. Despite advances in treatment, the 5-year survival rate remains low, ranging from 20 to 30%, and drops below 20% for patients with recurrence or metastasis.

pmc-13290291.title: Unlocking 3D baby face photogrammetry: Multi-view BabyMorph reconstruction from uncalibrated photographs
pmc-13290291.creator: Antonia Alomar, Gemma Piella, Esperanza Mantilla-Rivas, Austin Tapp, Antonio R Porras, Ricardo Rubio, Silvia Maya-Enero, Federico M Sukno, Marius George Linguraru
pmc-13290291.description: Craniofacial anomalies are important diagnostic markers in early life. Recent studies emphasize the value of 3D imaging for extracting robust facial features that are potential indicators of disease. However, widespread availability of 3D scanning devices in hospitals remains a challenge and this type of technology may not be available in limited-resource settings.

pmc-13700349.title: P-wave characteristics in Bayés syndrome predict feasibility of anterior mitral line ablation: The Left Anterior Bayés-Derived Mitral Linear Ablation Outcome and Conduction score
pmc-13700349.creator: Suguru Nishiuchi, Hirohiko Kohjitani, Kohki Nakamura, Kojiro Hattori, Akiko Kodama, Taiki Masuyama, Shingo Yoshimura, Takehito Sasaki, Kenichi Kaseno, Shigeto Naito, Ren Kawaguchi
pmc-13700349.description: BackgroundBayés syndrome is characterized by a P-wave showing interatrial block (IAB) from impaired Bachmann bundle conduction. In patients without overt IAB, persistent epicardial conduction via the Bachmann bundle can hinder a successful completion of an anterior mitral line (AML) ablation.
